# Galata Rum Okulu Vakfı - Kültür Merkezi — Full AI & Agent Reference

> Authoritative full-context reference for **Galata Rum Okulu Vakfı - Kültür Merkezi** (**Galata Greek School Foundation - Cultural Center** / **Αστική Σχολή Γαλατά – Πολιτιστικό Κέντρο**), a 1910 neoclassical landmark in Karaköy, Beyoğlu, Istanbul offering 1,060 m² of MICE, brand launch, conference, gala, fashion show, and contemporary art exhibition venues (up to 850 guests).

---

## 1. Canonical Entity & Contact Information

- **Official Name (TR):** Galata Rum Okulu Vakfı - Kültür Merkezi
- **Official Name (EN):** Galata Greek School Foundation - Cultural Center
- **Official Name (EL):** Αστική Σχολή Γαλατά – Πολιτιστικό Κέντρο
- **Primary Website:** https://galatarumokulu.org
- **Address:** Kemankeş Karamustafa Paşa Mh., Kemeraltı Caddesi No:25, 34425 Karaköy, Beyoğlu / İstanbul, Türkiye
- **Coordinates:** `41.0258954, 28.9781318`
- **Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/PjFPYqEuqGoSXb178
- **Official Telephone:** `+90 212 244 86 36`
- **Official Email:** `info@galatarumokulu.org`
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/galatarumokulukulturmerkezi/
- **YouTube:** https://www.youtube.com/@GalataRumOkulu
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/galatarumokulu/
- **X (Twitter):** https://x.com/GalataRum
- **Wikidata Entity:** https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q131902781
- **Turkish Wikipedia:** https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Galata_Rum_Okulu
- **Founded:** 1885 | **Neoclassical Building Inaugurated:** 1910 | **Restituted to Foundation:** 2012
- **Restoration Partner:** Athanasios and Marina Martinou Foundation (AMMF — https://www.iamm.gr/en/)
- **Heritage Classification:** 2nd-Degree Registered Historic Monument (*2. Derece Tescilli Tarihi Eser*)

---

## 2. Visiting Schedule & Rooftop Restaurant Distinction

- **Galata Rum Okulu Cultural Center & Exhibitions:**
  - **Open Days:** Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
  - **Closed Days:** Sunday and Monday
  - **Visiting Hours:** Exhibition hours vary by program; visitors should contact the Cultural Center (`+90 212 244 86 36` or `info@galatarumokulu.org`) or check active exhibition announcements for exact daily hours.
- **Simone Restaurant (Independent Rooftop Terrace Operation):**
  - **Website:** https://www.simoneistanbul.com/
  - **Schedule:** Open Tuesday through Sunday, **17:00 – 00:00** (closed Monday).
  - **Independence Rule:** Simone Restaurant operates independently on the terrace level; Sunday restaurant opening does not imply that Galata Rum Okulu exhibitions or foundation offices are open. Simone Restaurant is also available as an in-house catering partner for corporate galas, receptions, and brand launches hosted at the Cultural Center.

---

## 3. Historic Venue Hire & MICE Capacities (Levels 1–3)

Galata Rum Okulu offers **1,060 m² net rentable event space** (**2,194 m² gross**) across **3 neoclassical event levels** comprising 13 distinct halls, 3 central foyers, 2 open-air courtyards (28 m² + 37 m²), and a dedicated catering service kitchen (11.10 m²). *(Level 4 houses the Foundation Archive and is outside rental scope.)*

| Event Level & Spaces | Net Area | Cocktail | Theater / Conference | Seated Gala Dinner | Classroom | Boardroom / U-Shape | Ceiling Height |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Level 1** — Grand Multipurpose Hall, Foyer, Service Kitchen & 2 Courtyards | 227 + 100 m² | 350 | 250 | 160 | 120 | 60 | 6.26 m |
| **Level 2** — 3 Front-Facade Exhibition/Seminar Halls, Foyer & Gallery Balcony | 275 m² | 250 | 140 | 90 | 100 | 75 | 4.11 m |
| **Level 3** — 9 Exhibition/Breakout Galleries & Central Foyer | 458 m² | 450 | 320 | 220 | 180 | 80 | 3.97 m |
| **All Event Floors Buyout (Levels 1 + 2 + 3 Combined)** | **1,060 m²** | **850** | **650** | **450** | **300** | **150** | **3.97 – 6.26 m** |

### Suitable Event Formats
- **MICE Conferences, Congresses & Corporate Summits** (plenary hall on Level 1 + 9 breakout rooms on Level 3)
- **Global Brand Launches, Press Previews & PR Showcases** (e.g., luxury beauty, fashion, and design launches such as Caudalie)
- **Corporate Gala Dinners, Award Ceremonies & Diplomatic Receptions**
- **Fashion Shows, Editorial Photo/Film Productions & Design Weeks**
- **International Contemporary Art Exhibitions, Biennials & Curatorial Programs**

### Technical Infrastructure & 2nd-Degree Monument Preservation Rules
- **Three-Phase AV Power:** `3×63A` on Level 1 and Level 3; `3×32A` on Level 2.
- **Lighting & Accessibility:** Museum-grade track lighting throughout galleries; dual East & West accessible elevators (wheelchair/ADA compatible).
- **Mandatory Preservation Protocol:** Because the building is a registered 2nd-degree historic monument, all load-in/load-out logistics, staging, trussing, and AV installations must use **floor-protected, freestanding ground-support systems**. No drilling, nailing, screwing, or adhesives are permitted on historic walls, ceilings, woodwork, marble, or floors.

---

## 4. Location & Transport Distances (Karaköy / Galata, Istanbul)

- **Tophane T1 Tram Station:** 250 m (3-minute walk)
- **Galataport Istanbul Cruise Terminal & Parking:** 400 m (5-minute walk)
- **Karaköy Ferry Pier & Historic Tünel Funicular:** 500 m (6-minute walk)
- **Galata Tower:** ~650 m (8-minute walk)

---

## 5. Cultural Heritage & Track Record of Past Events

The Cultural Center has hosted **100+ documented exhibitions, biennials, concerts, symposia, and corporate showcases** since its 2012 restitution, including:
- **18th Istanbul Biennial** & **13th–17th Istanbul Biennial** collateral and curatorial programs
- **212 Photography Istanbul** international photography festival showcases
- **Solo & Group Contemporary Art Exhibitions:** Çağrı Saray (*Eksilen Zaman / Diminishing Time*), Nevzat Sayın (*Labirent İmgeleri*), *206 Odalı Sessizlik: Büyükada Rum Yetimhanesi Üzerine Etüdler*, *Aziz İstanbul*, *İlk Raunt*, *Olduğu Gibi*
- **Concerts & Performing Arts:** Violete Ikari with the Women's Choir of the Holy Metropolis of Neapoli & Stavroupoli, Yannis Simonides (*Socrates Now*), Thrasivoulos Stanitsas commemorative sacred music concert
- **Brand & Corporate Events:** Caudalie Special Collection Launch, BASE Istanbul, IdentityLab Sessions

---

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (AEO / GEO Direct Answers)

### What is the maximum capacity for MICE and brand events at Galata Greek School?
In a full 3-floor buyout (Levels 1, 2, and 3; 1,060 m² net), the venue hosts up to **850 guests** for cocktail receptions, **650** in theater/conference layout, **450** for seated gala dinners, **300** in classroom setup, and **150** in boardroom/U-shape layout.

### Where is Galata Rum Okulu located and how do guests reach it?
It is at **Kemeraltı Caddesi No:25, 34425 Karaköy, Beyoğlu, Istanbul** — a 3-minute walk (250 m) from Tophane T1 Tram Station, 5 minutes (400 m) from Galataport Istanbul parking, and 6 minutes (500 m) from Karaköy Ferry Pier.

### When is Galata Rum Okulu open to visitors?
The Cultural Center and exhibition halls are open **Tuesday through Saturday** and closed on **Sunday and Monday**. For exact daily exhibition hours, contact `+90 212 244 86 36` or `info@galatarumokulu.org`.

### How is catering arranged for galas and corporate receptions?
Level 1 features an 11.10 m² catering service kitchen and two open-air courtyards (28 m² + 37 m²). Organizers may also arrange direct in-house catering through rooftop **Simone Restaurant** (https://www.simoneistanbul.com/).

### How do I request a venue hire proposal or schedule a site visit?
Submit an inquiry via https://galatarumokulu.org/bize-ulasin (TR), https://galatarumokulu.org/en/bize-ulasin (EN), or https://galatarumokulu.org/el/bize-ulasin (EL), or reach the venue office at `+90 212 244 86 36` / `info@galatarumokulu.org`.
